site.title: Yuktarth Nagar · Product Manager
site.description: Yuktarth Nagar, Product Manager with 6+ years in edtech and fintech. I ship products end to end, not just roadmaps.

experience.title: Where I've put it into practice.

bullets: Own product for **CLMS**, ConveGenius's platform for centralizing content creation, tagging, translation, and distribution across client instances, including government education department partners
Lead the platform's five core modules: User Management, Content Management (CMS), Learning Management, Export Management, and Master Data (LO) Management
Took the **Assessment Creation flow** from an engineering prototype to a production-ready feature, writing a 13-section PRD (~35 requirements) covering UX, acceptance criteria, and edge cases
Targeting a drop in assessment creation time from hours to **under 5 minutes** for non-technical content managers and curriculum leads
Implemented rapid prototyping and validation cycles to accelerate discovery and reduce development overhead
Owned product vision and roadmap for chatbots on **SwiftChat**, a conversational learning platform impacting 150M+ students nationwide
Partnered with design, engineering, content, and partnerships teams to launch scalable learning products
Improved engagement by **269%** through iterative A/B testing and feature experimentation
Defined product success metrics and introduced data tracking dashboards for data-informed decision-making
Managed AI and automation projects across business functions, achieving an **80% increase** in digital engagement
Directed a cross-functional team of developers and testers, leading 11+ project deliveries
Designed project architecture using flowcharts and UML diagrams; coordinated API framework integration
Managed SIT/UAT cycles and owned stakeholder communication end to end

testimonialsSection.title: What people say about working with me.

testimonials.quote: I've worked with Yuktarth for over three years, including more than a year as his direct manager. He has a good grasp of technical concepts, which helps him collaborate smoothly with engineering teams. He is especially strong when it comes to documentation and follow-through — clear PRDs, structured specs, and well-maintained trackers are areas where he brings a lot of discipline to the team.
testimonials.name: Sri Nitya Anupindi

testimonials.quote: Yuktarth is the 'silent warrior' you are looking for. It is rare to find a professional who combines a Computer Science background with an MBA and actually utilizes both skill sets equally well. In a chaotic environment, he is the anchor: calm, composed, and obsessively organized. If you want a Product Manager who delivers beyond par, hire Yuktarth.
testimonials.name: Yashdeep
testimonials.role: AI Technical Product Lead · hired Yuktarth

testimonials.quote: I had the pleasure of working with Yuktarth during his tenure in the AI Project Management team at SBI Card, and he consistently demonstrated exceptional ownership, technical clarity, and a strong problem-solving mindset. What truly sets him apart is his ability to coordinate seamlessly across stakeholders, vendors, developers, and testers.
testimonials.name: Bhrigu Rana

testimonials.quote: As a Product Manager, he expertly managed numerous internal and external feature releases on our customer care digital assistant and smart agent assist solution, consistently achieving minimal issues post-launch. He possesses a fantastic blend of technical understanding and business acumen.
testimonials.name: Puneet Singh
